question: Which of the following countries will host the 19th Heads of Government Council meeting of Shanghai Co-operation Organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first time** that a Summit-level Meeting will be held under India’s Chairmanship.
 
• Prior to the creation of **SCO in 2001**,** Kazakhstan, China, Kyrgyzstan, Russia and Tajikistan** were members of the Shanghai Five.
 
• The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) is a** Eurasian political, economic and security organization**.
 
• Shanghai Five (1996) emerged from a series of border demarcation and demilitarization talks which the four former Soviet republics held with China to ensure stability along the borders.
 
• India and Pakistan joined on** 9 June 2017 **Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO).
 
• The official working language of the SCO Secretariat is Russian and Chinese.​
